neighbours.label: the 'and' / comma that joins 'sustainable' (or a green-economy adjective) to a next quality (sustainable and | resilient, regenerative, | circular)
fire: The city wants a sustainable and inclusive transport network by 2030.
Our goal is a more sustainable, low-carbon economy for the region.
The farm follows regenerative and organic methods on every field.
Investors are backing sustainable and responsible mining projects.
They design circular, zero-waste packaging for local brands.
We are committed to building an environmentally sustainable and fair supply chain.
The fund supports sustainable, climate-resilient housing in coastal towns.
The plan promises a greener and more sustainable future for farmers.
quiet: The city wants a fast and affordable transport network by 2030.
Our goal is a more competitive, export-driven economy for the region.
The farm follows traditional and careful methods on every field.
Investors are backing profitable and well-managed mining projects.
They design colorful, eye-catching packaging for local brands.
We are committed to building a reliable and efficient supply chain.
The fund supports affordable, well-built housing in coastal towns.
The plan promises a brighter and more prosperous future for farmers.

notes: Top: 'sustainable and green', 'sustainable and resilient', 'regenerative, circular', 'such as zero waste'; output promotes ' circular' and suppresses ' sustainable' (predicts the next green adjective). Probe: 'sustainable and resilient' 0.85, 'sustainable, ethical' 0.71, 'fast and reliable' 0.00. Near misses keep the 'X and Y' shape with non-green adjectives.
